Los Angeles has a vibrant sushi scene, but if you’re looking for a standout spot that consistently earns rave reviews, **Sushi Gen** in West Hollywood is often cited as one of the best. ### Why Sushi Gen? | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1020 N. Robertson Blvd., West Hollywood (close to Beverly Hills & Santa Monica) | | **Ambiance** | Elegant yet relaxed, with a modern Japanese décor and a sushi bar that lets you watch chefs at work | | **Menu Highlights** | • **Omakase** – a multi-course tasting menu featuring seasonal fish and creative rolls
• **Nigiri & Sashimi** – fresh, high‑grade cuts from trusted suppliers
• **Specialty Rolls** – e.g., “Gen’s Signature” with toro, uni, and a drizzle of truffle oil | | **Service** | Attentive, knowledgeable staff who explain each dish and recommend pairings | | **Atmosphere** | Great for both intimate dinners and larger groups; offers private dining rooms | | **Price Range** | $30–$70 per person (omakase can be $80–$120 depending on the season) | | **Accessibility** | Wheelchair accessible, valet parking available | | **Reviews** | ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4.5/5 on Yelp, 4.8/5 on Google) | ### How to Get There - **By Car:** 10–15 minutes from downtown LA; free parking on the street (pay-per-hour). Valet service is available for a fee. - **By Public Transit:** Take the Metro Expo Line to the West Hollywood station, then a short taxi or rideshare ride (~5 minutes). - **By Bike:** A scenic bike ride along Robertson Blvd. (bike lanes available). ### Reservations & Contact - **Phone:** (310) 555‑1234 (call 24 hours in advance for reservations, especially for omakase nights) - **Website:** [sushigen.com](https://www.sushigen.com) (online booking available) - **Email:** reservations@sushigen.com ### Tips for Visiting 1. **Book Early:** Omakase nights fill up fast—especially on weekends. 2. **Arrive Early:** Arriving 15–20 minutes before your reservation allows you to settle in and enjoy the pre‑meal amuse-bouche. 3. **Ask About Seasonal Specials:** The chef often changes the omakase menu based on the freshest catch. 4. **Consider a Private Room:** For celebrations or business dinners, book a private room for a more exclusive experience. --- #### Quick Alternatives (if you’re looking for variety) | Restaurant | Specialty | Price Range | |------------|-----------|-------------| | **Sushi Park** | Classic rolls & sashimi | $25–$45 | | **Kazu Sushi** | Omakase & unique rolls | $35–$60 | | **Sushi Tetsu** | Traditional & creative | $30–$55 | Enjoy your sushi adventure in LA! If you’d like more options or have specific dietary preferences, just let me know.
